provenance.quaternion_convention: xyzw; local goal axes relative to container body
provenance.method: Original fixed goal OBB retained: measured container interior, historical 39 mm clearance plus 3 mm margin and support-based floor bound. No fruit-specific goal recalibration in the randomized runtime.
provenance.object_position_semantics: Live PhysX center of mass and linear velocity of the episode-selected thing pool rigid body (episode.object_prim_path).
provenance.goal_calibration: Existing OBB retained unchanged from the original orange-skin calibration; not recalibrated for larger fruits. This region is not a fruit-specific containment/success certificate.

success_detector.geometry: 32 inner-floor mesh vertices at z=0.010474557988345623; convex floor hull, conservative extrusion to lowest rim vertex with mesh z>0.117
success_detector.bounds: all enabled selected-fruit collision mesh vertices, transformed through live fruit and intended container rigid-body poses
success_detector.qualification: elapsed simulation time across contained observations; duplicate time adds nothing; exit or invalid measurement clears pending dwell; no callback-gap cutoff
success_detector.success_semantics: episode_success_once; latched until episode/physics reset or simulation-time rollback; independent of terminal

provenance.object_pool_normalization: Scenario-local definitions reuse existing lemon/orange bodies and lunchbag/ketchup body promotion; preserve source mass/inertia, geometry and contact profile. Static parking cradles; no per-episode topology changes.

placement_provenance.method: V3: right region is the V2 object rectangle; left region is the V2 container footprint centre plus its existing offset bounds. Swap roles randomly. Both footprints retain all support and clearance checks.
placement_provenance.container_method: V3: choose a random footprint centre in the role-assigned existing region (left: template collision footprint centre +/-60 mm; right: existing object rectangle). Translate from the captured template; preserve its rotation and Z. Independently sample the object in the other region. Both footprints plus 25 mm edge margin must be supported; reject robot/environment collisions and object/container overlap with 30 mm obstacle clearance. External table support still requires Isaac runtime validation.

randomization.collection_objects_note: Ambidextrous V4 only: lemon1, orange2, lunchbag, ketchup_bottle; all four bodies loaded before simulation.
